results.selection_rule: Learned only if lower normalized pinball in all three folds and selection
results.calibration_rule: Nonnegative expansion, rank min(n, ceil((n+1)*0.8)), calibration rows only
results.limitation: Reused historical development validation, not an independent test. Calibration treats player rows empirically; series dependence and temporal drift preclude an IID coverage guarantee. Component intervals do not validate causal impact, coaching advice, or a composite player score.

selection.selection_rule: Learned only if lower normalized pinball in all three folds and selection
